explication: `ant` is Anthropic’s Claude Platform CLI. Its main workflow turns resource commands and flags into API requests, then presents the response in terminal-friendly formats. A separate declarative workflow loads resource files, plans changes against remote state and a lockfile, previews the plan, and applies approved changes. Session commands also support live interactive work. The graph preserves the README’s documented capabilities, but source excerpts are incomplete; links for unsampled subsystems are therefore limited to relationships the README documents.
